# Actual SF7 recording with a weak SFD

English · [简体中文](说明.md)

Actual Pager control near 478.475172 MHz, BW500/SF7 and nominal −9 dBm; receiver center 478.5 MHz, rate 1.75 MS/s. The original three-second recording was cropped to [229376,458752): 229376 complex samples, 458752 bytes, approximately 0.131 seconds. Source facts and hashes are in `provenance.json`.

The transmitter's TX_DONE is not received-payload evidence. The old 11 dB detector reported only CSS candidates. The matched downchirp evidence was approximately 9.93 dB and quarter ending 8.14 dB. A conditional 2 dB downchirp tolerance, enabled only after an established consecutive preamble and the other structural checks, recovered this case. The ordinary search entrance remains unchanged. Negative controls, ARM qualification and repeated RF trials are separate evidence; this segment alone does not establish sensitivity or payload/CRC recovery.
